name: Calendar Heatmap
summary: Values on a calendar: one cell per day (trading activity, volumes) with a sequential scale, or a year × month grid of monthly returns with diverging colours and a compounded full-year column.
summary_zh: 日历热力图：按日（交易活跃度、成交量，顺序色）或按年 × 月网格（月度回报，发散色、单元格标注百分比、复利全年列）展示时间数据。
description_zh: daily 模式使用 ECharts 日历坐标系，每天一个格子（周一至周日为行、周为列），适合看交易活跃度、成交量、事件密度的季节性与异常日；颜色为主题顺序色，数据偏态时自动改用 5 档分位数图例（scale = auto）。monthly 模式是基金/股票“月度回报表”：行是年份、列是月份，以 0 为中点的发散色着色并在格中标注数值，右侧为按月复利的全年（未满一年为 YTD）列，可加各月平均行看季节性。图例可拖动筛选数值区间。
best_for: Monthly TSR or fund returns table with full-year compounding
avoid_when: Fewer than ~2 months of daily data
Values where the exact level matters more than the pattern (use a line chart)
More than ~3 years in daily mode (cells get too small)

value.desc: Value to colour (daily value or monthly return)

month.desc: Monthly mode: month as 1–12 or Jan–Dec

mode.desc: daily (calendar of days) | monthly (year × month grid)

format.desc: Value format; defaults to the value field format

scale.desc: Daily colour scale: auto | linear (draggable continuous legend) | quantile (5 buckets); auto picks quantile for skewed data

range.desc: Daily: [from, to] ISO dates; default = whole months spanned by the data

weekdays.desc: Daily weekday rows: 'auto' (Sat / Sun rows only when data falls on a weekend) | 'all' | 'weekdays'

yearTotal.desc: Monthly: full-year column (YTD for partial years)

compound.desc: Monthly: compound monthly returns into the year column (false = simple sum)

totalLabel.desc: Monthly: header of the full-year column

avgRow.desc: Monthly: bottom row with the average of each calendar month

labels.desc: Monthly: print formatted values in the cells

interactions: Hover tooltip (weekday, date, value vs. period average; or month / YTD details)
Drag the legend handles or toggle legend buckets to filter cells
Cells fade in as a diagonal wave (monthly)

samples.title: Monthly TSR heat strip (oldest first, no labels)
